text: I've only had the X2 for about five days now. I'm a bit annoyed because the ear cushions are very uncomfortable if I really want to use them for hours. On the upside, sound is pretty good and the ANC handles my noisy commute. You get a solid 30 hrs on the battery. App is glitchy though, disconnects often. At $149 the value is really good. I'd recommend it, but its value only works if you can put up with the clamping pressure or use them with breaks.
